legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: UNLOCKED ("we", "us", or "our") operates the unlocked.gr website. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our Service.
legal.privacy.section1_text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a booking, or contact us. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and booking preferences.
legal.privacy.section2_text: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process bookings, send you notifications about your reservations, and communicate with you about promotions and updates.
legal.privacy.section3_text: We share your booking information with escape room companies to fulfill your reservations. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
legal.privacy.section4_text: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
legal.privacy.section5_text: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your personal data. Contact us at privacy@unlocked.gr to exercise these rights.
legal.privacy.section6_text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@unlocked.gr.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the unlocked.gr website operated by UNLOCKED.
legal.terms.section1_text: By accessing or using our Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you disagree with any part of the terms, you may not access the Service.
legal.terms.section2_text: Bookings made through UNLOCKED are subject to the availability and policies of each escape room company. Cancellation policies vary by provider. Please review the specific terms before confirming your booking.
legal.terms.section3_text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.
legal.terms.section4_text: The Service and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by UNLOCKED and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.
legal.terms.section5_text: UNLOCKED shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the Service.
legal.terms.section6_text: These Terms shall be governed by the laws of Greece, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how UNLOCKED uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website unlocked.gr.
legal.cookies.section1_text: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the owners of the site.
legal.cookies.section2_text: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, account access, and language preferences. You cannot opt out of these cookies.
legal.cookies.section3_text: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website. This helps us improve our service. These cookies collect information anonymously.
legal.cookies.section4_text: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that removing or blocking cookies may impact your user experience.
legal.cookies.section5_text: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at privacy@unlocked.gr.

about.title: About
about.hero_subtitle: We're on a mission to revolutionize how people discover, book, and experience escape rooms. One puzzle at a time.
about.mission_text: To create the ultimate platform connecting escape room enthusiasts with unforgettable experiences. We believe every puzzle solved and every room escaped brings people closer together.
about.vision_text: To become the global go-to platform for escape room discovery and booking — empowering both players to find their next adventure and businesses to reach new audiences.
about.value1_desc: We live and breathe escape rooms. Our team of enthusiasts curates only the best experiences.
about.value2_desc: Real reviews, verified ratings, and honest listings. What you see is what you get.
